Before you startread this first
  • Work every problem on paper the way you would on test day, then enter the answer here.
  • Answer everything. There is no penalty for guessing, and a blank is always wrong.
  • Use Flag on anything you want to come back to. The question sheet at the bottom jumps anywhere.
  • Typed answers: fractions like 3/4, mixed numbers like 2 1/4, decimals like 1.5, negatives like -7. Dollar signs and percent signs are fine. Fractions in simplest form unless told otherwise.
  • Progress saves on this device, so you can close the tab and come back.
  • This test was created by AI and reviewed by Joey, working backwards from the published state standards only — see the note at the bottom of the page.
